clockmap.source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED: tools/clockmap defaults; step threshold is PROPOSED by that tool. Matches T7 sender's default ClockMap.

pty_timeout_s.rationale: PROPOSED: bounded local subprocess/PTY diagnostic timeout; not a robot deadline.

synthetic_pose_age_ns.rationale: ASSUMED: synthetic source is one millisecond before the local software injection boundary.

silence_policy_overrides.source: PROPOSED: diagnostic-only override isolates receipt-silence from source-age and heartbeat expiry. Never deploy these as safety limits.

synthetic_policy_overrides.source: PROPOSED: diagnostic-only override absorbs host startup/scheduling delay in synthetic clock-mapped PTY scenarios. Never deploy these as safety limits.

uart.rationale: CALCULATED: ideal 8N1 = start + 8 data + stop bits. PROPOSED full-capacity comparison only; no hardware margin established. Baud rates required by T10.

evidence_max_bytes.source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED: T10b requires retained evidence under 200 kB; full captures are temporary and excluded from the archive.
